**Finding submitted: deviation (WARRANTY).**

**What I checked**
- **Section 9 "Warranties" (p0055–p0058)** — only mutual corporate-authority representations plus a Globix Agreement acknowledgement. No performance standard, no conformance warranty, no period, no remedy.
- **Article 1, HDI's Responsibilities (p0005–p0014)** — performance covenants (design, host, maintain, promote), not warranties; §1.6's only consequence of late launch is a termination right, not a warranty remedy.
- **§7.2 (p0045)** — compliance with laws, but confined to marketing/advertising and mutual, so it does not cover the Services or the Site.
- Targeted searches for "AS IS", disclaimer/merchantability/implied, professional/workmanlike, conform/documentation, malicious code/virus, and repair/replace/refund/re-perform returned nothing — so there is neither an express warranty nor a disclaimer to carve out.

**Classification** — every fallback element fails (no ≥90-day software conformance warranty, no ≥30-day Services warranty, no repair/replacement, no refund), so per the detection guidance a missing express warranty is a deviation to be cured by insertion.

**Redline (validated ok:true)** — a single new Section 9(c) inserted after p0058 carrying all preferred elements in one sentence pair: professional and workmanlike Services warranted for 90 days; 12-month conformance of the Site, software and deliverables to documentation; compliance with applicable laws; no malicious code; with re-performance, repair or replacement, or refund at HDI's option. The comment offers the fallback (90 days software / 30 days Services, same remedies). Section 9 already survives two years post-termination under §10.7, so no separate survival change was needed.
